cases.sentence: Генерал, за которым скакал Пьер, спустившись под гору, круто повернул влево и Пьер, потеряв его из вида, вскакал в ряды ___, шедших впереди его.
cases.explain: «пехотных солдат» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Having descended the hill the general after whom Pierre was galloping turned sharply to the left, and Pierre, losing sight of him, galloped in among some ranks of infantry marching ahead of him. He tried to pass either in front of them or to the right or left, but there were soldiers everywhere, all with the same preoccupied expression and busy with some unseen but evidently important task. They all gazed with the same dissatisfied and inquiring expression at this stout man in a white hat, who for some unknown reason threatened to trample them under his horse’s hoofs.

cases.sentence: Он пытался выехать из них то вперед, то влево, то вправо; но везде были солдаты, с ___, занятыми каким-то невидным, но очевидно важным делом.
cases.explain: «одинаково-озабоченными лицами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.

cases.sentence: Впереди его был мост, а у моста, стреляя, стояли ___.
cases.explain: «другие солдаты» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: There was a bridge ahead of him, where other soldiers stood firing. Pierre rode up to them. Without being aware of it he had come to the bridge across the Kolochá between Górki and Borodinó, which the French (having occupied Borodinó) were attacking in the first phase of the battle. Pierre saw that there was a bridge in front of him and that soldiers were doing something on both sides of it and in the meadow, among the rows of new-mown hay which he had taken no notice of amid the smoke of the campfires the day before; but despite the incessant firing going on there he had no idea that this was the field of battle. He did not notice the sound of the bullets whistling from every side, or the projectiles that flew over him, did not see the enemy on the other side of the river, and for a long time did not notice the killed and wounded, though many fell near him. He looked about him with a smile which did not leave his face.

cases.sentence: Сам того не зная, Пьер заехал к мосту через Колочу, который был между Горками и Бородиным, и который в ___ сражения (заняв Бородино) атаковали французы.
cases.explain: «первом действии» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.

cases.sentence: — Сейчас, сейчас, — отвечал адъютант и, подскакав к ___, стоявшему на лугу, что-то передал ему и тогда уже обратился к Пьеру.
cases.explain: «толстому полковнику» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “One moment, one moment!” replied the adjutant, and riding up to a stout colonel who was standing in the meadow, he gave him some message and then addressed Pierre.

cases.sentence: — Здесь-то слава Богу, — сказал адъютант; — но на ___ у Багратиона ужасная жарня идет.
cases.explain: «левом фланге» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Here it’s tolerable,” said he, “but with Bagratión on the left flank they’re getting it frightfully hot.”

cases.sentence: Тут только в ___ Пьер увидал раненых, бредущих пешком и несомых на носилках.
cases.explain: «первый раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It was only now that he noticed wounded men staggering along or being carried on stretchers. On that very meadow he had ridden over the day before, a soldier was lying athwart the rows of scented hay, with his head thrown awkwardly back and his shako off. “Why haven’t they carried him away?” Pierre was about to ask, but seeing the stern expression of the adjutant who was also looking that way, he checked himself.

cases.sentence: На том ___ с пахучими рядами сена, по которому он проезжал вчера, поперек рядов, неловко подвернув голову, неподвижно лежал один солдат с свалившимся кивером.
cases.explain: «самом лужке» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.

cases.sentence: Проехав в дыму по ___, позади артиллерии, которая, выдвинутая вперед, стреляла, оглушая своими выстрелами, они приехали к небольшому лесу.
cases.explain: «шестому корпусу» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Having ridden in the smoke past the Sixth Corps, behind the artillery which had been moved forward and was in action, deafening them with the noise of firing, they came to a small wood. There it was cool and quiet, with a scent of autumn. Pierre and the adjutant dismounted and walked up the hill on foot.
